summary: Episode with expert investor Gilmore discussing his investment philosophy focused on special situations with clear triggers. Main topics: Millicom - Xavier Niel takeover creating value in Latin American telecom duopolies; Castellum - Achelius restructuring story with potential for three-way split; Eastnine - Polish office REIT with distressed acquisition opportunity; Resurs - completed special situation with forced buyout. Gilmore emphasizes finding overlooked situations rather than following crowd favorites.
key_takeaways: Gilmore focuses on special situations with clear structural changes or triggers, not just cheap valuations
Millicom remains attractive despite doubling due to Iliad's cost-cutting and Colombia consolidation creating oligopoly pricing power
Castellum represents a turnaround opportunity aligned with one of Sweden's best real estate operators (Achelius)
Special situations like Resurs (forced buyout, clean loan book) can offer outsized returns with clear catalysts
Avoid investments where valuation is disconnected from fundamentals even if popular or associated with famous founders
